nodes.text: The St. Augustine Medical Laboratory Limited (STAML) has confirmed the first recent diagnosis of Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) in T&T. The virus is spread through direct contact between people, or when someone touches a contaminated surface. Read more here: https://t.co/hWYYxsEpOM https://t.co/goXS7yywfQ
